description: Convert within one declared scope per call: iso3 is required and names one ISO3 country, GLOBAL, or MARINE. A batch uses one from_system, to_system, and crosswalk_id, with at most 25000 requested result rows. Convert X -> loc_id -> Y; omit to_system to enter the loc_id universe. For admin or city names use from_system admin_boundary with a country_hint inside the declared country. A published direct crosswalk uses one selected artifact; if the system pair has multiple artifacts, supply crosswalk_id from the typed ambiguity error. An exact miss ends on that artifact. Use get_geography when family or scope coverage is unknown. The tools/list access metadata states authored free, account, and paid item allowances; active operator policy may waive payment.

admin_level_hint.description: Optional admin-level hint for admin/name resolution.

as_of.description: ISO date or year used for time-bounded identities.

batch_id.description: Optional caller-supplied batch id for tracing.

country_hint.description: Optional country hint for admin/name resolution (USA), or a subdivision to search within (USA-OR). Names may also carry their parent: 'Washington County, Oregon'. Ambiguous names return candidates instead of a match.

crosswalk_id.description: Exact published crosswalk ID when the source/target system pair has multiple artifacts. A route ambiguity error lists valid IDs.

from_system.description: Input reference system, such as admin_boundary (admin and city names; admin_text and place_name are accepted aliases), zip, overlay_zcta, nws_fire, tribal, or loc_id.

iso3.description: Required scope pack for the entire call: one ISO3 country, GLOBAL, or MARINE. Every item must stay within this scope.

items.description: Reference conversions within one scope and one source/target/crosswalk route. Split mixed routes. Maximum requested item count times per-item limit is 25000.
